name: Race Right
author: Addicting Games
description: Race Right is a free racing game. there are a lot of ways to race. You can do it in cars, on motorcycles, with jets, and yes even using speedboats. Race Right is all about using your skills to race the right way and bring victory home. Just point, click, drift, and slide your way into victory as you avoid obstacles, arena walls, and all sorts of other annoying things. This is a physics-based gravity puzzler where your job is to navigate a speeding boat through a series of levels which become increasingly difficult as the game goes on. Do you have what it takes to make it to the end and become the race master? Prove it in this game of fast turns and blisteringly fast straightaways. Dominate the leaderboard and devastate your friends in this epic racing game of skill, patience, and pure speed. In some games, you light off nitrous in order to power up. This game is all nitro all the time, you just have to figure out how to get on top of it and stay ahead of the momentum in order to properly control your roll and blast your way past the finish line.
